innertube.note: Built-in table as of 2026-10-01 (checked against yt-dlp on Android 2026-09-07). Edit profiles here to fix clients without a release.

brain.note: The music brain's off switches (docs/brain-spec.md, 3.7). refresh: the once-a-day background search for new music. A missing key means on.
brain.sourcesNote: The open-data sources the brain reads (stage 2b). Set one to false to switch it off on every phone, for instance before charging anyone: deezer and musicbrainz and listenbrainz carry non-commercial terms. A missing key means on.
